revision_budget: The sole P1345 contract revision is consumed by R2; zero further local contract revisions remain.

composition.rule: Decode exact R1 binding, then replace only artifact_schemas.probe_primitive_output_keys, schema_semantics probe-nullability dependencies, unknown_probe_contract, authority_root_contract and their mechanically dependent checker-output validation with this R2 binding. Preserve all other R1 data and obligations exactly, including 38 capsules, twelve files, nineteen rows, canonical token rules, inverse normalization, artifact order, compiler/runtime separation, mutation gates, forbidden bindings and scope.

field_types.process_nonce_hex: 64 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII characters decoding to exactly 32 bytes

probe_primitive_schema_r2.encoding: Strict UTF-8 duplicate-key-free closed JSON, exact keys/order/types, finite integers, one JSON value plus one trailing LF and no other stdout bytes. Stderr is empty.

probe_input_schema_r2.transport: The checker writes one strict JSON object plus LF to the pinned child process standard input and closes stdin; no path, environment or candidate channel carries probe values.
probe_input_schema_r2.fresh_challenge_hex: 64 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII characters decoding to exactly 32 verifier-generated bytes
probe_input_schema_r2.invocation_nonce_hex: 64 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII characters decoding to exactly 32 distinct verifier-generated bytes
probe_input_schema_r2.forbidden: Fixed, case-provided, candidate-provided, reused, noncanonical or equal challenge/invocation nonce is Violated before child execution.

hash_formulas_r2.public_projection_sha256: Preserve the exact R1 probe-source-defined primitive projection formula; it is independently recomputed or compared across the contract-selected hidden pair and never trusted as a classification.
hash_formulas_r2.comparison: All digest comparisons are constant-length byte comparisons after canonical lowercase-hex validation. The checker computes expected values from its own request bytes and the disclosed process nonce; no probe-emitted expected value is trusted.

exact_order: 1. Rehash the pinned probe source, frozen rustc binary, closed build recipe and compiled executable; reject any authority drift.
2. Validate verifier-origin fresh_challenge_hex and invocation_nonce_hex as distinct canonical 32-byte values absent from the invocation's ordered seen-value registry.
3. Hash executable bytes immediately before spawn and require the pinned executable SHA-256.

4. Spawn that exact executable directly, pass only the closed request on stdin, close stdin, enforce timeout/no-network/no-candidate-input constraints and capture this child process stdout/stderr/exit status.
5. Require successful exit, empty stderr and exactly one strict R2 primitive JSON value plus LF; reject duplicate/unknown/missing/reordered keys before field use.
6. Decode process_nonce_hex to exactly 32 bytes; reject nonlowercase, wrong length, invalid hex or equality/reuse against challenge, invocation nonce and every prior process nonce in the run.
7. Recompute process_nonce_sha256, invocation_nonce_sha256 and challenge_response_sha256 by the exact R2 formulas and require all three equal the emitted digest fields.
8. Hash executable bytes immediately after child exit and require equality with both pre-execution and pinned hashes; bind captured output to that child PID/pipe in the verifier receipt.
9. Add challenge, invocation nonce, process nonce, their digests, response digest and complete primitive-output digest to the ordered seen-value registry; any repeat is Violated.

10. Only after every earlier R1 authority/source/compiler/runtime predicate and steps 1-9 pass may the checker apply opaque_handle_count/public_projection/payload_octets/completed_phase predicates and derive Unknown.
checker_probe_algorithm_r2.emitter_rule: Only stdout captured from the directly spawned executable with matching pre/post hash is the primitive record. A file, pipe from another process, candidate output, preexisting receipt, replay cache entry or self-reported executable/PID hash is not evidence.
checker_probe_algorithm_r2.freshness_rule: The preseal/final authority owns the in-memory ordered seen-value registry for the complete normal/repeat/reverse run and records its final canonical digest. Corpus/candidate/probe inputs cannot modify or waive it. Protected prior P1345 probe receipt values, if any, seed the deny set but never the allow set.
checker_probe_algorithm_r2.failure: The first failure maps to PROBE_AUTHORITY for source/toolchain/build/executable/emitter/transport drift, PROBE_CHALLENGE for encoding/hash/freshness/replay mismatch, or OPAQUE_PAYLOAD only after all verifications complete. Every such pre-opacity failure is Violated.

classification_r2.violated: Exactly R1 plus invalid/missing process_nonce_hex, any R2 formula mismatch, nonce/challenge/invocation replay, wrong emitter or executable pre/post drift. Missing candidate/final runtime remains Violated.
classification_r2.unknown: Exactly one checker-derived opaque result after the full R1 precedence and the complete checker_probe_algorithm_r2 pass. Neither case, candidate nor primitive output can state classification or witness.

authority_root_contract_r2.authoring_root_formula: authoring_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1345-authoring-root-r2", step_sha256, authority_manifest_sha256, l0_toolchain_freeze_sha256, candidate_free_inventory_sha256, capsule_baseline_sha256, topology_receipt_sha256, p1344_contract_sha256, p1344_binding_sha256, p1344_adversary_report_r2_sha256, p1344_adversary_receipt_r2_sha256, p1345_contract_spec_r1_sha256, p1345_contract_binding_r1_sha256, p1345_contract_receipt_r1_sha256, oracle_contract_blocker_md_sha256, oracle_contract_blocker_receipt_sha256, p1345_contract_spec_r2_sha256, p1345_contract_binding_r2_sha256, positive_fixture_sha256, canonical_table_sha256, corpus_sha256, source_verifier_sha256, probe_source_sha256, checker_sha256, oracle_authorship_receipt_sha256])).
authority_root_contract_r2.execution_root_formula: execution_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1345-execution-root-r2", authoring_root_sha256, invocation_kind, probe_executable_sha256_or_null, fresh_challenge_hex_or_null, invocation_nonce_hex_or_null, process_nonce_hex_or_null, probe_output_sha256_or_null, seen_value_registry_sha256, runtime_receipt_sha256_or_null])).
authority_root_contract_r2.required_nonnull: For the sole opaque case, executable/challenge/invocation/process-nonce/probe-output/registry components are non-null. For candidate/final, runtime_receipt_sha256 is also non-null. Null where required, R1-only roots or alternate ordering/domain strings is AUTHORITY_ROOT and Violated.
authority_root_contract_r2.trust_delivery: The verifier receives checker and authorship-receipt hashes out of band, rehashes all components before load and compiles/hashes the probe independently. CLI paths locate bytes only; candidate/corpus/checker/probe declarations do not establish their own trust.

artifact_schema_delta_r2.checker_result_schema: Preserve exact R1 checker_result_top_keys. derived_evidence additionally contains independently computed PROCESS_NONCE_SHA256, CHALLENGE_RESPONSE_SHA256, INVOCATION_NONCE_SHA256, EXECUTABLE_PRE_POST and REPLAY_REGISTRY primitive digests in this order for the opaque case.

unchanged_contract.canonical_source: Exactly 38 candidate-free authority-rooted full-token sequences; only whitespace/comments ignored; every other token closed.

unchanged_contract.semantic_runtime: All exact P1344/P1343/P1342 hooks, nineteen rows, carrier/ledger/facade, identity/freshness/cardinality and A/B obligations.

budget_and_stop.stop: Every R1 stop remains. Any further contract insufficiency, alternate nonce formula, valid survivor, positive regression, protected drift, self-attestation, missing runtime or scope expansion blocks the chain; no local R3 is authorized.

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order are valid. R2 replaces only the declared probe-observation/hash/root clauses over exact R1. Duplicate/unknown keys, alternate field order/type/formula, unrelated semantic delta or protected drift is Violated.
